---
title: "About"
---

**GNSS Notes** publishes engineering notes, measurements, tutorials, implementation observations, research-related material and practical discussions in GNSS and PNT.

The publication is intended to be technical rather than promotional. Products, software or test equipment may be referenced when they are relevant to the subject.

## Authorship

Authorship is selected article by article. Articles may use an individual author's real name, a collective editorial byline, or no prominent byline where that is more appropriate.

AI systems are not presented as human authors. When material AI assistance is worth disclosing, it can be stated in an editorial note.
